description: This file defines classes for Redis cache backends, including support for Redis and Redis Sentinel, with methods for setting, deleting, publishing, and streaming data, as well as configuration loading.

classes.name: RedisCacheBackend
classes.description: A Redis cache backend supporting standard Redis operations with optional SSL configuration.

classes.name: RedisSentinelCacheBackend
classes.description: A Redis Sentinel cache backend supporting Sentinel-based Redis clusters with SSL support.

methods.name: from_config
methods.description: Creates an instance of the cache backend from a configuration dictionary.
